_doc: THE BURST, looked at alone (SW-86; RUNNING_LOG §290 — his word: 'can I just see just the burst … plain small note heads, but put them in appropriate staff'). The workshop's page 'burst' draws ONLY the notes each hand plays inside its own time span, as plain heads on that hand's staff, at their played times. page = the IR the notes are read from · hands: L / R = [from, to] in seconds · view = what the page shows.

curtain._note: §296 · §298 · §299 — THE SCATTERED STRIKE: a transparent block over the stretch where the strike's notes fall (padSs each side, at least minSs wide; the grand staff and overSs beyond each staff), and a HANDFUL OF PEBBLES thrown in it. The pebbles: species and sizePx (synthesi-alpha's substrates, tools/substrate.js), density = how many. THE THROW is ballistic: each pebble a parabola lasting about flightS seconds (flightSpread = how much the pebbles' flight times differ, as a share), landing about the IMPACT — the moment the cursor reaches the curtain's middle — scattered across the floor by landSpread (a share of the curtain's width); one bounce keeping `bounce` of the speed, then still.
